Why should fixed sleeps be avoided in automation?

Fixed sleeps pause execution for an arbitrary amount of time. They can make tests slower and may still fail when application timing changes. Waiting for a meaningful application condition is generally more reliable.

How do I launch a browser using Playwright Python?

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
browser = p.chromium.launch()
page = browser.new_page()
page.goto("https://example.com")
print(page.title())
browser.close()
This example launches Chromium, creates a page, navigates to a URL, prints the page title, and closes the browser.
